Project: curated-list
Version: 1.0.0
Framework: Astro v4 (static site generation)
Language: TypeScript

================================================================================
PROJECT ARCHITECTURE
================================================================================

This project is a fully static product directory website. All pages are
pre-rendered to HTML at build time. There is no server, no database, and no
client-side JavaScript. The site is CDN-friendly and can be deployed to Netlify,
Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, or any static host.

Data flow:
  Markdown files -> Astro Content Collections -> Static page generation -> dist/

Content model:
  Products are the only content type. Each product is a single Markdown file
  with YAML frontmatter. The file slug (filename without extension) becomes
  the URL slug for the product detail page.

================================================================================

================================================================================
CONTENT COLLECTION SCHEMA
================================================================================

File: src/content/config.ts

The products collection uses Astro Content Collections with Zod validation.
All fields are validated at build time. A type error will abort the build.

Schema fields:
  title        : z.string()                    — product name (required)
  description  : z.string()                    — short description (required)
  price        : z.string()                    — price string, e.g. "$999" (required)
  image        : z.string()                    — absolute path, e.g. /images/foo.jpg (required)
  category     : z.string()                    — lowercase, e.g. "office" (required)
  affiliate_link: z.string().url()             — full URL (required, validated)
  featured     : z.boolean().default(false)    — shows in Featured section (optional)
  tags         : z.array(z.string()).default([]) — searchable tags (optional)

================================================================================
HOW TO ADD A PRODUCT
================================================================================

1. Create a new file: src/content/products/your-product-name.md
   The filename (without .md) becomes the URL slug.
   Use lowercase and hyphens: "my-product.md" -> /product/my-product

2. Add frontmatter at the top of the file:

   ---
   title: Your Product Name
   description: A concise description of the product.
   price: $149
   image: /images/your-product.jpg
   category: office
   affiliate_link: https://example.com/product
   featured: false
   tags:
     - tag1
     - tag2
   ---

3. Optionally add body content in Markdown below the frontmatter.
   This content renders on the product detail page below the product info panel.

4. Add the product image to: public/images/your-product.jpg
   Recommended dimensions: 800x600px (4:3 aspect ratio)

5. Run: npm run build
   The new product will appear on the homepage, its category page, and at /product/your-product-name

================================================================================
HOW PAGES ARE GENERATED
================================================================================

Homepage (src/pages/index.astro):
  - Calls getCollection('products') to fetch all products
  - Filters products where featured === true for the "Featured" section
  - Derives unique categories via Set() from all product.data.category values
  - Renders CategoryFilter (links) and ProductGrid components

Category pages (src/pages/category/[category].astro):
  - Uses getStaticPaths() to generate one page per unique category
  - Categories are derived dynamically from product frontmatter (no hardcoded list)
  - Each path receives filtered products as props
  - Adding a new category requires only creating a product with that category value

Product pages (src/pages/product/[slug].astro):
  - Uses getStaticPaths() to generate one page per product
  - slug = filename without .md extension
  - Calls product.render() to get the Content component (rendered Markdown body)
  - Calls getCollection('products') again to find related products (same category)
  - Injects JSON-LD Product structured data into <head> via named slot

================================================================================
HOW ROUTING WORKS
================================================================================

Astro uses file-based routing. Files in src/pages/ map to URL routes:

  src/pages/index.astro                -> /
  src/pages/category/[category].astro -> /category/:category (dynamic)
  src/pages/product/[slug].astro      -> /product/:slug (dynamic)

Dynamic routes require getStaticPaths() which returns an array of
{ params, props } objects. Each object generates one HTML page.

At build time, Astro calls getStaticPaths() for each dynamic route file,
generates all paths, renders each page to static HTML, and writes to dist/.

================================================================================
HOW CATEGORIES ARE DERIVED
================================================================================

Categories are NOT hardcoded anywhere. They are computed at build time:

  const allProducts = await getCollection('products');
  const categories = [...new Set(allProducts.map(p => p.data.category))].sort();

This means:
  - Adding a product with category: "gadgets" automatically creates /category/gadgets
  - Removing all products from a category removes that category page
  - The CategoryFilter component receives the computed list and renders links

The nav links in Layout.astro ARE hardcoded (office, audio, productivity).
Update those manually when adding new major categories.

================================================================================
HOW TO BUILD THE PROJECT
================================================================================

Prerequisites:
  - Node.js 18+ (LTS recommended)
  - npm (included with Node.js)

Commands:
  npm install          Install dependencies (creates node_modules/)
  npm run dev          Start dev server at http://localhost:4321 with HMR
  npm run build        Build static site to dist/ (production)
  npm run preview      Serve the dist/ folder locally to preview the build
  npm run astro        Run Astro CLI commands directly

Build output:
  All generated HTML, CSS, and assets are written to dist/
  dist/ is self-contained and can be uploaded to any static host

================================================================================
PERFORMANCE DESIGN DECISIONS
================================================================================

- Zero client-side JavaScript (no React, no Vue, no framework runtime)
- CSS is inlined when small enough (controlled by build.inlineStylesheets: 'auto')
- HTML is compressed at build time (compressHTML: true)
- Images use loading="lazy" on cards, loading="eager" on hero product images
- Images use decoding="async" to avoid blocking rendering
- Sticky header uses CSS only (no JS scroll listeners)
- Category filtering is done via navigation links (no JS filter)
- All fonts use system font stack (no web font downloads)

================================================================================
SEO DESIGN DECISIONS
================================================================================

- Each page has unique <title>, <meta description>, canonical URL
- Open Graph tags on all pages (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url)
- Twitter card tags on all pages
- Product pages include JSON-LD structured data (Schema.org Product type)
- Semantic HTML: <header>, <main>, <footer>, <article>, <nav>, <section>
- Breadcrumb navigation with aria-label and aria-current
- Category badges and filter links use proper anchor tags (crawlable)
- Affiliate links use rel="noopener noreferrer sponsored"
